publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Sabino

record.title: Sensor cleanup on one shutdown route
record.method: Finite trial, ordered UART continuation and frozen-code inference
record.observation: A sibling trial records 100 samples, finite restoration, stock sync/unmount return, zero busy buffers and zero native drain; automatic Jumpdrive recovery takes 78.210 seconds.
record.limits: Parent CLEANUP/CLEAN_STATUS execution is inferred from the pinned unique success continuation, without a direct success marker. Callback join, unload, motion publication and rotation remain unproven.
